description: Use this when the user has seen a workout preview and clearly said to save it. It saves that preview to the connected Phorme account as a private workout and returns a link that opens it in Phorme. It needs a connected Phorme account with the training:write permission. Retrying with the same idempotency_key returns the same saved workout and does not create a second copy.

confirmation.description: Set to true only after the user clearly confirmed this save in the conversation.

idempotency_key.description: A unique string for this save. Reuse the same value when retrying so no second copy is created.

preview_id.description: The preview_id of the preview being saved.

name: save_workout_to_phorme

open_url.description: Link that opens the saved training in Phorme.

title: Save workout to Phorme
